entries.description: Core brand configuration: app name (Avuz Conecta), user agent, copyright, URLs (login, privacy, source, signup, app store), URL scheme (avuzconecta://), app groups, primary color (#f2f6fb), and feature flags (disable_show_more_nextcloud_apps_in_settings, disable_information_section_in_settings)
entries.notes: NCBrandOptions and NCBrandColor classes. On upgrade, check for new feature flag properties added upstream — they won't exist in our copy and may cause build errors. loginBaseUrl is intentionally empty (server URL entered by user at login).

entries.description: Brand images: full app icon set (all sizes), logo (1x/2x/3x), 4 onboarding intro screens
entries.notes: Binary files, no conflict risk. If upstream adds new required icon sizes, add them to AppIcon.appiconset.

entries.description: Info.plist files for all targets: CFBundleDisplayName set to 'Avuz Conecta', URL scheme avuzconecta://, BGTaskSchedulerPermittedIdentifiers (app.avuz.conecta.refreshTask, app.avuz.conecta.processingTask), document group app.avuz.conecta
entries.notes: On upgrade, check if upstream adds new plist keys (capabilities, background modes, etc.). File_Provider_Extension_UI.plist was previously missed and showed 'Nextcloud' — was fixed.

entries.description: App group entitlements across all targets: group.app.avuz.conecta and group.app.avuz.conecta.apps. Keychain access group: app.avuz.conecta
entries.notes: Must stay in sync with NCBrand.swift capabilitiesGroup values and Apple Developer portal App Groups. If upstream adds a new extension target, create a corresponding entitlements file.

entries.description: Removed 'Sign up with provider' button and 'Host your own server' link from the intro/login screen. Only the Login button remains.
entries.notes: Removed @IBOutlet buttonSignUp and buttonHost, their viewDidLoad setup, and their @IBAction handlers. Storyboard updated to remove both button subviews and fix layout constraints — login button now anchors to safe area bottom.

entries.description: Wrapped the entire 'Information' section (Acknowledgements, Privacy, Source Code) in a guard on NCBrandOptions.shared.disable_information_section_in_settings. Set to true in NCBrand.swift so the section is hidden.
entries.notes: On upgrade, if upstream restructures NCSettingsView.swift, this patch may conflict or silently stop wrapping the section. Verify the Information section is still hidden after rebasing.

entries.description: Removed LucidBanner-based notification UI (3 files deleted). Replaced with JGProgressHUD-based NCHud and JDStatusBarNotification-based NotificationPresenterUI.
entries.notes: LucidBanner introduced its own UIWindow overlay which conflicted with firstWindow logic. All call sites referencing showErrorBanner/showHudBanner/showUploadBanner were updated throughout iOSClient/ to use the new APIs. On upgrade, watch for upstream adding new LucidBanner call sites.

entries.description: Replaced upstream's mainAppWindow (complex window filtering that excluded LucidBanner overlays) with a simpler firstWindow implementation that returns keyWindow of the first connected scene.
entries.notes: Consequence of lucid-banner-removal. If upstream changes mainAppWindow behavior or renames it, these call sites need updating. On upgrade, search for any new mainAppWindow usages introduced upstream.

entries.description: pt-BR translation overrides replacing 'Nextcloud' with 'Avuz Conecta' in user-facing strings
entries.notes: Binary .strings file. On upgrade, upstream may add or rename translation keys. Reapply branding overrides after pulling new upstream translations.
